figure3.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a finished publication illustration for a Chinese mathematical modeling paper about drying a root-like herbal material. White background, very wide landscape canvas 3840 by 1280 pixels (3:1), crisp labels readable when printed at 160 mm wide. Energetic but restrained scientific-journal style, navy #17324D outlines and text, blue #2878B5, teal #179A92, coral #E66B4E accents. No decorative background, no figure number, no watermark.

Input image 1 is a MATERIAL APPEARANCE REFERENCE showing actual herbal root strips, not an edit target. Input image 2 is a CUT-SURFACE TEXTURE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Use their natural beige-brown longitudinal skin and pale fibrous cut face as visual inspiration. Do not reproduce their cluttered backgrounds or imply the new illustration is an experimental photograph. No species name.

Compose two main regions horizontally:
LEFT about 29%: heading exactly "(a) 药材外观原型". Show ONE isolated, photorealistic elongated near-cylindrical herbal root segment on white, oriented horizontally, natural fine longitudinal wrinkles, slightly irregular skin, pale circular cut face visible on its right end, subtle realistic contact shadow. No leaves, no dramatic branching, no tissue/cellular diagrams. Caption underneath exactly "外观示意".
MIDDLE narrow connector: a single clean navy arrow pointing from the real-looking root to the abstract cylinder, label exactly "几何理想化".
RIGHT about 62%: heading exactly "(b) 一维径向物理模型". A mathematically regular translucent pale-blue cylindrical body, horizontal with length visibly much larger than diameter, clean dark-blue outline, flat elliptical end faces. Center axial line thin dashed; one teal radial midsection, center point, radial arrow from center to outer side with labels "r = 0" and "r". A dimension line beneath the cylinder labelled "L = 25 cm". The model initial radius text "R₀ = 2 cm". Coral arrows pointing inward to the curved lateral surface from above, labelled "侧面对流换热"; blue arrows pointing outward from the curved lateral surface below, labelled "表面失水". Absolutely no exchange arrows at either flat end. Place below the model the exact note "忽略轴向变化与端面交换". Use soft translucency solely for geometry, not numerical temperature or concentration values; no heatmap or color scale.
At far right within the model region, a compact separate circular cross-section inset, not connected by a time-evolution arrow: heading "问题四：给定半径". Concentric initial dashed blue circle and smaller current solid teal circle sharing center, radius arrows correctly ending at their own boundaries labelled "R₀" and "R(t)". Two short exact lines beneath: "长度不变" and "内部仿射运动为假设". Keep it visually subordinate to cylinder, with sufficient space to avoid collisions.
All Chinese typography clear, not calligraphic, ample spacing, minimum text approximately 64 pixels on this 3840-pixel canvas. Exactly the specified labels, no extra equations, no numerical results, no droplet/steam icons, no separate latent-heat mechanism, no axial transport arrows. Retain full layout and margins without cropping.

figure4b.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate a NEW finished schematic for panel (b) of a Chinese mathematical modeling paper. It explains only the SAME-INSTANT coordinate mapping from the shrinking physical radial domain to a fixed material reference domain, under an affine material-motion assumption. This is not a time evolution, not before/after drying and not physical expansion. No experimental data are shown.

Canvas: very wide landscape 3840 by 1280 pixels (3:1), white background, a refined scientific journal diagram, clean navy #17324D text, teal #179A92 physical-domain graphics, blue #2878B5 reference-domain graphics, a small purple #7B6DB0 mapping emphasis. Labels must be easily readable at 160 mm printed width, approximate minimum 64-pixel text at 3840 width. No outer box, no watermark or figure number.

Top left title exactly "(b) 移动物理域到固定参考域".
Use the left 72% of the canvas for two aligned horizontal radius bands, upper in teal and lower in blue. Center-origin endpoints of both bands align vertically.
Upper band label at its left "物理域". Draw one narrow rounded-free straight bar from center to current surface with three circular markers at its left end, its midpoint, and its right end. Above markers print exactly "r = 0", "rᵢ", "r = R(t)" respectively. Physical bar is about 70 percent of lower bar width, but lengths are arbitrary visual schematics, not measured values.
Lower band label at its left "参考域". Draw a narrow blue straight bar with three circular markers at left end, midpoint, right end. Below markers print exactly "x = 0", "xᵢ", "x = 1" respectively.
Join each pair of corresponding markers with slim grey dashed arrows pointing DOWNWARD: center-to-center, physical midpoint-to-reference midpoint, surface-to-reference surface. Start and end arrows just outside bar edges, no collision with marker labels. Label the mapping arrows collectively "同一时刻的坐标映射" in open space between bands. Do not cross any arrows. Add subtle endpoint descriptors "中心" below x=0 and "表面" below x=1.
In the right 25% place a beautifully typeset large relation exactly "x = r / R(t)", with smaller inverse exactly "rᵢ = xᵢ R(t)" below. Below the formula add the exact note "表面始终对应 x = 1". No enclosing busy card.
At bottom, two short notes with ample separation:
"仿射运动假设下，固定 x 随物料运动"
"坐标示意，不表示物料膨胀"
All three pairs of points must be unambiguously linked and correctly labelled. Spatial mapping only: no t₁/t₂, no before/after, no drying arrows, no physical root illustration, no heat/water arrows, no animated movement trail, no plots, no scale units for x, no extra assumptions or unsupported formulas. Balanced scholarly composition, precise alignment, crisp text, large margins and no cropping.
